ideas.title: The 3AM Email Test
ideas.concept: A post challenging business owners to check what's sitting in their inbox at 3AM that should've been handled hours ago. Visual would show a split screen: a stressed founder at a laptop vs. an N8N workflow dashboard quietly processing leads, replies, and bookings overnight. Demonstrates how Claude AI + N8N + GoHighLevel run the business while you sleep.
ideas.hook: If your business stops making money the moment you close your laptop, you don't have a business. You have a job.

ideas.title: The $10K Hire You Don't Need
ideas.concept: A direct callout post comparing the cost of hiring a VA or ops manager ($4-10K/month) vs. building a Claude-powered automation stack that handles emails, CRM updates, and client onboarding 24/7. Visual would be a mock job listing crossed out, replaced with a clean Accelod automation architecture diagram (Google Workspace → Claude → N8N → GoHighLevel).
ideas.hook: Stop hiring humans to do robot work. You're not building a team, you're building a payroll problem.

ideas.title: What I'd Automate First (If I Were You)
ideas.concept: Alfie shares the exact 3 workflows he'd build in week one for any service business: lead qualification via Claude, follow-up sequences in GoHighLevel, and internal reporting through Google Workspace, all stitched together with N8N. Visual would be a whiteboard-style breakdown or Alfie talking to camera with workflow overlays animating in.
ideas.hook: Everyone wants AI. Almost nobody knows where to start. Here's exactly what I'd build first if this was my business.
